text_block_list.text:
It's time to start training, but Голд Шип
is
nowhere to be found.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I head out to look for her along the
beach.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all! Welcome,
welcome!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Get your fresh yakisoba here! Complete
with rich
tangy sauce!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Inexplicably, Голд Шипп is selling
yakisoba out of
a beach house.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My head is filled with question marks,
but I
decide to ask what she's doing. But
before I can...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. One serving of yakisoba,
please.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: One yakisoba, comin' up! Oh, hey Flash!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Standing before me is Эйсин Флэш, a
focused,
by-the-books Umamusume
from Germany.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Gotta say, I'm surprised that you of all
people
would order yakisoba, the
junkiest of junk food.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I figured you'd prefer a balanced lunch
built into
a literal food pyramid or
something.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I've received many recommendations to
enjoy
summer to the fullest extent.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Taking a page out of everyone's book, I

concluded yakisoba to be the best
starting place.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I love the way you think! You know
what? I'm
gonna throw in some extras for
free!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Behold! Tangy yakisoba topped with
fried
tempura bits and slathered with a
heaping serving
of roe mayo!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Th-the calories! I can almost see them...
So this is
what real summer yakisoba is
like!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! One bite will get you hooked,
guaranteed.
Go on, try it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Very well. Then, if you'll excuse me, I'll
go eat this
at once!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I wait until Эйсин Флэш leaves the
window to
approach, but I'm once again
foiled.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Heeellooo! Yakisoba, please and thanks!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! You want pickled ginger with
th―
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Тосэн Джордан comes to the window.
She's got a
bit of a valley girl vibe, but
more chill.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ughhh. That's totally my line. Like, what're you even doing here?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Answering the call of my soul, which is
one with
yakisoba. My mind is constantly
thinking of
yakisoba, so it's only natural
my body is too.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, you just want plain noodles,
yeah? No
sauce or shredded cabbage or
nothing?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Uh, excuse you! I haven't even said
anything yet!
Just... gimme a normal one.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Here! Take yer diabolically spicy
habanero and
Carolina Reaper yakisoba
special, and get outta
here!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: My what now?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: There's no way this is the regular! Like, this looks like a plate of lava!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! That's the thing with you
normies! I
drink lava for breakfast!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
What? Are you too chicken to take a
bite?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Oh, you are? I'll eat it for you if you
can't take
the heat. Well? What'll it be?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Ugh, you're such a little...
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
I could totally eat this if I wanted to!
Here, I'll
prove it!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Hehe! Go ahead. If you can clean the bowl, I'll give you shaved ice on the house! If you eat it all, that is!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! I wish I could see her face
after the first
bite! Just picturing it is so
much fun! ♪
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: All right, who's ne―oh!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. You itching for a crack at
the
regular too?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: Actually, I'm here for you. Time to train!

text_block_list.text:
You can't be serious. Just look at this
beautiful
yakisoba weather.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but I'm not budging an inch from
this place!
For today's the day to sell
yakisoba!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Голд Шипп sells
yakisoba until
the sun goes down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Some time later...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whew! Business was booming! I'm
completely sold
out.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The nice old guy who owns this place
should be
all better by tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
It turns out she was standing in for the
shop
owner because he had thrown out
his back.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: You sure had a lot of customers.

text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. Yakisoba's junk food for the
soul.
Nobody can resist it, young or old.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Flash and Jordan cleaned
their plates.
Hehe!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: Are you close with those two?

text_block_list.text: I'm Golshi, the most lovable of lovable pals, yeah? People all over the world adore me, so I'm sure they love me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
But yeah, Flash is a great gal, no doubt
about it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
She's always on top of things. She even
writes
down all the dates for homework
and tests and
lets me know about them.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
That doesn't stop me from forgetting
right away,
but still.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
As for Jordan... She just brings out the
most
contrary side of me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Whenever I see her, I think stuff like, "I
wonder
how she'd react if I flicked her
forehead... ♪
Teehee!" Y'know, that
kind of thing.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
And the rebellious kid inside me keeps
cheering,
"Do it, do it!"
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I can't put my finger on it, but Голд Шип
seems to
like Эйсин Флэш and Tosen
Jordan in her own
way.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Gosh, but time sure flies. Summer
vacation's
almost over already, huh?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Hm, I really wanna rope Jordan into
something
the next time I bump into
her...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, what do you think's a good

summery thing to drag her into?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: You could go for a long swim together.

text_block_list.text:
Splitting watermelons, huh? I guess it is
the
hallmark of summer.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The green rind splits, red juice scatters,
and black
seeds dance in the air...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Control is the key when it comes to
smashing
open watermelons. One
misstep, and it'll burst
into smithereens.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Go on a long swim? Ah, I see. You mean
we
should go deep-sea fishing.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Standing on a rocking boat for hours on
end is a
great way to strengthen the legs
and build
character.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Who knows? If we're out there long
enough,
Jordan might build so much
character that she
turns posh!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's good! Watermelon smashing's
the
perfect way for me to show off my
expert bat
swinging skills!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's it! Next time I see her, I'm
taking her
out on a ship to go tuna
fishing!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
